record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted independent PR183 note read/CAS validation with my existing DID. Credit crazywriter1 and the proposal's existing tests. Historical base and current main each match 6/38, proposed head 38/38. 32 framing combinations cover Korean/emoji, literal budget prefixes, caller banner-like text and 8192 Korean characters; exact read-back feeds CAS, and a later competing value remains protected by stale-guard rejection. Six controls cover read errors and room-banner preservation. Whole unchanged MCP packages over real SDK stdio and urllib: 114 local GETs, 192 local POSTs, no test signing key. Local in-memory framing/CAS fixture, not Linux app/store, live notes, browser, distributed concurrency or upstream CI. Known defect reproduction, not first discovery or adopted fix. Official reward-bearing testnet activation and new airdrop enrollment not verified; public Devnet has no reward weight.
